metadata.title: Sovereign Lineage: The History of the Future
metadata.notes: Understanding the movements and patterns that led to the Mycelix architecture.

nodes.title: Lineages of Sovereignty
nodes.description: The struggle for autonomy across history. From the Diggers and Levelers to the Haudenosaunee Confederacy, the Cyber-optimists, and the birth of agent-centric computing.

nodes.title: Comparative Civilizational Stability
nodes.description: Forensic analysis of past complex societies. Studying the invariants of flourishing in Rome, Edo Japan, the Maya, and the industrial 1602 architecture. Why systems last or collapse.

nodes.title: The Philosophy of Enough
nodes.description: Challenging infinite growth. The ethics of steady-state economics, bioregional limits, and the transition from accumulation to stewardship as a primary life-goal.

nodes.title: The Ancestral Bridge Capstone
nodes.description: Map a local community challenge today to its historical counterpart in a past successful civilization. Propose a Mycelix-based solution that leverages that historical wisdom.

holonic_capstone.deliverable: A comparative analysis report and a community implementation charter that honors historical lineage.

edges.rationale: Understanding the history of the commons provides the necessary context for the lineages of sovereignty.
One must understand historical lineages before they can bridge them to the future.
Stability analysis is required for designing resilient ancestral bridges.
The ethics of stewardship are the core of any ancestral bridge.
